gloss: to make fun of, to mock, to look down on

definitions.gloss: to make fun of, to mock, to belittle
definitions.explanation: To treat someone or something as foolish or unworthy of respect; to ridicule or look down on.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧バカにした⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧。
examples.english: An attitude that looks down on people.

examples.japanese: バカにされて⟦{悔|くや}しい→悔しい：02343_kuyashii⟧。
examples.english: It's frustrating to be made fun of.

examples.japanese: バカにしないで⟦ちゃんと→ちゃんと：02359_chanto⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: Stop mocking me and listen properly.

notes:
バカにする is a common casual expression meaning to mock or belittle someone. It's quite direct and can be offensive when used seriously.

Variations:
- ⟦{馬鹿|ばか}→馬鹿：03574_baka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (kanji form - less common in casual use)
- {小|こ}バカにする (to subtly mock)

Related expressions:
- ⟦{見下|みくだ}す→見下す：09911_mikudasu⟧ (to look down on - more literary)
- なめる (to underestimate/disrespect - slang)
- ⟦からかう→からかう：07353_karakau⟧ (to tease - lighter tone)

"バカにするな！" is a very common angry response when someone feels disrespected.
